svg.title: Repo constellation
svg.desc: A green phosphor radar scope sweeps the repo constellation; blips flare as the beam passes and fade with phosphor persistence. Groups: FastAPI patterns (fastapi_practices, fastapi_sql_aws_base); Frontend and 3D (Babylon_Vue with Vue 3 and Babylon.js PBR, react-basics-rejuvenation, AngularInMemoryCompanyAdmin); Containers (flask_mongo_dockerized, heroku_deploy_flask); DSA galaxy (dsa_algo with 140 files, blind_leetcode_python with 53 problem files); Tools (github-stats, Flask and pygal language charts).
